title: Use Performance Monitor to Collect Event Trace Data

facts.text: Start Performance Monitor and create Data Collector Set under User-defined with event trace data type.
Add Microsoft-DynamicsNAV-Server provider to collect trace events in Data Collector Set wizard.
Filter specific trace events by keyword decimal value in Properties list and Manual field.
Keyword values: service calls (4), AL functions (8), sum values for multiple events (e.g., 12 for both).
Increase trace buffer settings to minimum 128 size, 50 minimum and maximum buffers to prevent dropped events.
Start Data Collector Set to begin recording and stop to end recording trace event data.
Collected data stored in .etl file viewable with PerfView or other industry-standard tools.
